branding.visualStyle: Lavender store screens frame white app screens, flat cartoon people and illustrated symptom icons. Feather pink #FF5A7D marks period days, card outlines and the Log period pill; only the sleep screen turns dark plum.
styleTraits: Lavender #E2CBFF fills 37% of the store screens
8 of 8 headlines set line 2 in a pale pink box
Insight cards: 16 px corners, 3 px pink outlines

screenshots.alt: Headline “Predict your next period” above a week strip with 5 predicted days, “Period in: 2 days”, a pink Log period button and a green FSA/HSA eligible sticker
Headline “Understand your fertile days” above a calendar: period on days 1 to 5, fertile days 12 to 18, ovulation predicted on day 17
Headline “Log and track symptoms” above a card of 3 logged symptoms, Cramps, Mood swings and Fatigue, over a phone held in a cartoon hand
Headline “Maximize your connection” above Flo for Partners: an illustrated couple, a Daily tip notification and 2 cards, Her day today and a Both question
Headline “Got symptoms? Get answers” above the Symptom Checker: PCOS a significant match, then endometriosis, uterine fibroids and perimenopause as low matches
Headline “Manage symptoms of perimenopause” above 3 suggested topics, a grey Go to insights button and illustrated articles such as Periods in your 30s and 40s
Headline “Discover your sleep-cycle connection” above a dark plum screen: a Good sleep score on cycle day 12, 8h 10m asleep against 7 to 9h recommended
Headline “Follow your baby’s growth” above a week strip at 7 weeks, 5 days, an embryo render and “Your baby this week”, the size of a blueberry

ourRead: 3 goals get their own product name: Ovulation & Health tracker ($11.49, $14.99), Birth Control Reminder ($43.99), Pregnancy Tracker ($49.99). The receipt repeats why you came.
The first screenshot wears a green “FSA/HSA eligible” sticker, U.S. only. It turns Premium, up to $59.99, into a health expense paid with pre-tax money.
All 8 screenshots sell features, from period predictions to pregnancy. Prices, $1.99 to $59.99, show only in the In-App Purchases list. Value first, price later.

improvements.title: Add the length to all 10 names
improvements.detail: 6 listings share the name Flo Premium, from $1.99 to $59.99. Keep the goal names and add the term to each, like “Flo Premium, 1 year”.
improvements.rule: Fix 3 things to stop a design from looking cheap: low contrast, a broken layout, and copy that does not convert.

improvements.title: Darken the button pink to 4.6:1
improvements.detail: White “Log period” on #FF5A7D reads at 3.0:1. Fill the pill with #D9345E, the same hue, for 4.6:1, and keep #FF5A7D for the icon and period days.
improvements.rule: Text contrast: at least 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for text 24 px and larger.

improvements.title: Keep pink for period days and the button
improvements.detail: Screen 1 puts pink on 5 predicted days, the Log period pill and 2 card outlines. Drop the 3 px outlines from all 6 insight cards on screens 1, 2 and 4.
improvements.rule: One accent per screen. Directing attention means one place to look.

stylePrompt: Build a paywall in Flo's style. Top to bottom: a medium sans line, then the key words large in a pale pink box with 10 px corners. Below: a white plan card and one pink pill button. Type: Inter 500 for text, Proza Libre for the boxed words. Colors: lavender #E2CBFF (60) for the screen, white #FFFFFF (30) for cards, feather pink #FF5A7D (10) for the button and the selected plan's 3 px outline. Plans: one tier in rows with length and price; preselect the longest and show its per-month price. Show a trial only if you offer one. Use my brand colors in the same 60/30/10 roles.
